business_rules: Password changes are rejected if the current password is incorrect, the new password is not confirmed, or it equals the previous password (RF-06).
Vacation requests follow a lifecycle of pending, accepted, rejected, and cancelled states (RF-08).
Vacation requests with an invalid date range are prevented (RF-09).
Vacation requests exceeding the employee's available balance are prevented (RF-10).
Vacation balance is calculated using only business days, excluding weekends and holidays (RF-11).
Annual vacation entitlement is prorated in the first contract year (RF-12).
Only approved requests are deducted from the vacation balance (RF-13).
Proposals follow open, accepted, and rejected states (RF-20).
Duplicating a proposal preserves its composition but does not reuse unique identifiers (RF-23).
Time is distinguished between counting and not counting toward the workday for correct worked-hours calculation (RF-28).
Evidence policies may be none, one-time, or weekly (RF-32).
Employees with recent activities in weekly-evidence projects and no attached proof are alerted by email (RF-33).
Total billing amount is calculated automatically from detailed items (RF-38).
Net amount payable is calculated automatically when income-tax withholding applies to self-employed suppliers (RF-39).
The primary due date of a billing record reflects the last scheduled payment date (RF-41).
Outstanding billing balance is calculated automatically from associated financial transactions (RF-44).
A billing record is marked paid when financial transactions cover the total due (RF-45).
Associating a billing record with a credit instrument changes the billing state and may optionally create a new due date (RF-46, RF-47).
Orders follow a workflow of created, approved, accepted, confirmed, validated, and completed states, with a preserved textual history (RF-59, RF-61).
A dedicated document category is automatically created and maintained for each user (RF-52).
Access to sensitive operations is restricted by scope: full, own-records-only, or by area (RNF-67).
Consistency is maintained between related modules (user/document folder, proposal/billing, billing/credit instrument) (RNF-71).

issues.description: The 'Operations and Continuity' capability (RNF-75..RNF-78: external storage for attachments/reports, startup configuration validation, automatic file-structure preparation, and toggling operational rules such as editing billing, LDAP, and notifications by configuration) has no corresponding service or explicit responsibility assignment. This is a distinct evidenced capability category with four requirements, and it underpins Document Management and Reporting outputs.
issues.recommendation: Either add a small Platform/Configuration & Storage service to own external attachment/report storage, startup validation, and config toggles, or explicitly assign these responsibilities (e.g., storage to Document Management, config toggles to the relevant owning services) so the capability is not dropped.

issues.description: RF-42 requires importing billable hours and project costs already recorded in operations into billing, implying Finance and Billing must consume data from Time and Activity. The candidate declares Finance -> Time and Activity, but Finance's own responsibility text and the CRM->Finance conversion path only cover proposal-to-billing (RF-24/RF-43). The operational-hours-to-billing flow (RF-42) is not reflected in any responsibility statement, risking a silently dropped integration.
issues.recommendation: Make explicit in Finance and Billing (or Time and Activity) responsibility that operational billable hours/costs are imported into billing per RF-42, confirming the Finance<->Time interaction covers this flow.

issues.description: RF-62 requires orders to send related documents by email and RNF-72 requires document/version traceability for commissions. Orders and Commissions communicates only with Time and Activity and Notification, but sending 'related documents' implies interaction with Document Management Service, which is not declared. Similarly RF-52 automatically creates a per-user document category, implying People/HR -> Document Management on user creation, which is declared, but the Orders->Documents link is absent.
issues.recommendation: Add an Orders and Commissions -> Document Management Service interaction to support sending/attaching order-related documents, or clarify how document attachments for orders are handled without that dependency.

Controls access by user profile and scope of responsibility, supports local and LDAP authentication, and applies access control to critical entities.
Sends email notifications for relevant business events such as vacation requests, contract expiry, pending evidence, and orders.
